# Rig checklist

In-game checks waiting for a batched rig run. A rig run never gates a merge. Each slice lists its checks in its PR description. After merge the coordinator copies them here, and removes a check once a rig run passes it at a build that still contains the change. This list authorizes no run.

Every check runs in a named disposable FT city in the isolated rig profile, never in Peter's ordinary save. Autosave is off before every measured window, including after a reload, and is restored at cleanup.

Detailed specs: [F8 §7](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/blob/a3a6c8db8686f4382ac3cf941010e0b614e48805/docs/plans/f8-capability-boundaries.md#7-in-game-checks-for-the-batched-rig), [F9 §7](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/blob/a3a6c8db8686f4382ac3cf941010e0b614e48805/docs/plans/f9-city-acceptance.md#7-in-game-checks-for-the-next-batched-rig), [E6 §7](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/blob/a3a6c8db8686f4382ac3cf941010e0b614e48805/docs/plans/e6-carts-food-trucks.md#7-in-game-checks-for-the-batched-rig), [F4 plan](plans/f4-perf-gate.md), [11j report](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/blob/a3a6c8db8686f4382ac3cf941010e0b614e48805/docs/checks/rig-2026-11-11j-mac-results.md), [12b report](checks/rig-2026-11-12b-mac-results.md). Checks written before 10 November are in the [docs history tag](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/tree/docs-history-2026-11-10/docs/checks); many test save migration, which no longer exists.

## 1. Re-run after later product changes

1. **Sales at the current head.** Setup: food, goods and service fixtures from 12b. Steps: repeat 12b's S2 food, goods, service and ceiling probes and the #233 cut and recovery arms. Expected: the 12b results unchanged. Needed because GR-3 (#234) and GR-4 (#236) changed the purchase path.
2. **PR checks since 12b.** The "In-game checks" lists in [#234](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/pull/234), [#236](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/pull/236), [#237](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/pull/237), [#238](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/pull/238) and [#239](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/pull/239). The coordinator copies them into this section. They cover needs purchases, venue readiness, staffed capacity, evenings and households, workplaces, through-traffic, own cars and bodies, and the RLO overlap rules.
3. **RLO overlap and own cars.** Setup: full modpack with RLO 1.0, Living population on, then off. Steps: load, run two game hours, save, reload. Expected: Persistent City overrules RLO where they overlap, as #239 specifies; no native car is borrowed; walkers and parked cars persist across reload (GR-9).

## 2. Shop menus and storms (E5b2 to E5b5)

Missing: original-three, mixed original and dynamic, eight- and nine-offer, catalogue lifecycle, metadata override, refill and resource, and 8- and 64-shop fixtures. The single-croissant fixture and `shop_edit` cannot add the holders and prices. Spec: [E5b probe](../tools/e5b-native-rig-proof/README.md).

4. **Mixed and original-three menus.** Expected: each offer sells at its own price, and catalogue changes reconcile without lost or duplicated receipts.
5. **Eight- and nine-offer menus, refill.** Expected: every offer is reachable; refill and resource use match native.
6. **Repair storms at 8 and 64 shops.** Expected: mutation storms reconcile; mod-work stays inside the perf gate.

## 3. Street Food, vehicle sales and research

7. **E6 checks 1 to 13** ([E6 §7](https://github.com/PeterHartwieg/big-ambitions-persistent-city/blob/a3a6c8db8686f4382ac3cf941010e0b614e48805/docs/plans/e6-carts-food-trucks.md#7-in-game-checks-for-the-batched-rig)). Missing: RIG-SFAPI, RIG-VLEDGER, RIG-SFFAULT.
8. **Street Food absent, then returned (F8-2).** Steps: save, load without FoodTrucks, run two hours, save, restore and load. Expected: `vendor.streetfood absent` with its reason; shop money equals a run with no cart; the cart requalifies after return. Missing: RIG-PCSAVE.
9. **Research and a truck in one city (F9-7).** Steps: order a neighbourhood snapshot, save and reload while it is pending, run to morning. Expected: one charge on that night's marketing bill, one report, receipts unique across reload. Missing: RIG-LIVE.
10. **Mechanism report (F8-9; 11j partial).** Expected: `shop.fullservice-bag.v1`, `vehicle.streetfood-api.v1`, and `shop.dynamic-catalogue off` for a non-historical product. 11j saw only the shop row.

## 4. Throughput and wholesale

11. **Representative throughput (F6b-2; 11j partial).** Setup: a cohort of staffed food shops. Expected: hourly completions against native MealsPerHour support a median and the default ceiling. 11j had one shop, which is not a cohort.
12. **Price response at weight 1.2 (F9-9).** Steps: raise every price by 50% in one copy for two days. Expected: fewer meals and revenue up by well under 50%. Native evidence, not calibration. Missing: RIG-LEDGER, RIG-PCCONFIG.

## 5. Saves, refusals and interrupted state

13. **Larger F7-1 matrix (11j partial).** Expected: Pending, same-minute fault, relocation and menu arms each keep identities, wallets and receipts across cold reload. Only F7-3's capture arm passed (12b).
14. **X3-1 literal read (11j partial).** Expected: the population read emits `Loaded` with schema 1. 11j saw the reload accepted but not that line.
15. **Unreadable or wrong-schema city refused and kept (F9-8).** Expected: the refusal status; payload and other PC keys byte-identical across a native save. Missing: a wrong-schema FT loader, RIG-PCSAVE.
16. **RLO absent at load (F8-4).** Expected: no city starts; status says RLO is required; payload hash unchanged; native customers serve the shop.
17. **Changed native members (F8-5 to F8-7).** Expected: the named capability goes `off`, the payload is unchanged, owned shops hand back at the next accounting boundary. Missing: RIG-FAULT.
18. **Foreign checkout prefix (F8-10).** Expected: `food.checkout.shop off: foreign prefix by <owner>`; zero PC receipts. Missing: RIG-FOREIGNPATCH.
19. **Business lifecycle (GR-1 checks 2, 3, 5).** Close and replace, modded type, older city. Missing: a lifecycle fixture, a modded-type fixture, a pre-GR-1 save.

## 6. Cadence, bodies, config and seven days (F9)

20. **Seven days with daily save and reload (F9-4).** Expected: PC extracts and native orders equal an uninterrupted copy; ledger conserved daily. Missing: RIG-PCSAVE, RIG-LEDGER, RIG-LIVE.
21. **Native changes across cadences (F9-5).** Frame caps 30, 60, 120 and a hidden skip. Expected: identical extracts; each change at the same minute; lag at most one game minute. Missing: RIG-FRAMECAP.
22. **Detail transitions and in-flight reload (F9-6; F2 matrix).** Bodies on and off. Expected: equal extracts and orders. 11j read movement diagnostics only. Missing: RIG-PCCONFIG.
23. **Provenance, capabilities and summary (F9-1 to F9-3, F9-10).** Expected: a declared fingerprint set, every capability active or inactive with a reason, one merged summary. Missing: RIG-ACCEPT.

## 7. Scale, presentation and performance

24. **Population and GC scale.** FT-F4-Stress10k and city-50k. Expected: M1 and M2 per the [F4 plan](plans/f4-perf-gate.md); GC spikes flagged. Missing: RIG-PCFIX.
25. **Sealed F4 fixtures and windows (F4f, F7e).** Missing: implementation and manifest sealing.
26. **Present, foreground and priority flow steps.** Missing: RIG-PRESENT, RIG-FOREGROUND, RIG-PRIORITY.
27. **Capability report cost (F8-11).** Expected: mod-work p95 under 5 ms; every spike of 30 ms or more listed with its component.

## 8. Owner input

28. **Pointer, hover, focus and click.** Peter's playtest, not the rig.
29. **Windows and PC-overlay rows.** Need the Windows rig.

System.ArgumentException: Cannot retime a maximum-size native car route without splitting its current edge.

- **night:** largest disjoint parent physical = 34,597,112 bytes, 50.81% of physical+advance. Largest advance subsegment `advance_planning` = 22,199,992 bytes (66.29% of advance). Appearance 15,030,256 bytes = **4.59% of 14b**; appearance excluding randomize and bake = 12,620,000; bake plus that remainder = 14,198,000 bytes = **4.33% of 14b appearance**. For clarity, the broader physical+advance residual is **19.67% / 15.70% of 14b**, above 10%; that is not the appearance/combiner trigger. No cause inside advance_events/planning is inferred from the names alone. #266's unimplemented entry projection and native spawn activation remain possible follow-up subjects, not proven causes here.

Bake scratch peaks at **45 sizes / 1,678 KB = 1.718 MB**, about **0.11% of the day Mono heap**. That is small against this heap and the model's 23 MB bake caches; the measured scratch does not support prioritizing a cap as the next slice. Scratch sizes/bytes reset when the physical population is recreated for speed mode; the report does not treat this as a process-wide permanent high-water mark.

### UpdateCity, mod-work, whole-frame and every >=30 ms mod-work spike

All windows used the rig union timer with UpdateCity, AdvancePopulation, route preparation, RunPhysical, inspector, body acquire, instantiate and dress components. Component timings are **self time**: children are subtracted. Thus the separately reported UpdateCity p95 is self time, not an inclusive UpdateCity percentile and not directly comparable to 14j’s single-component UpdateCity p95. Inclusive UpdateCity is bounded by the complete mod-work union in each frame, so union p95 <5 ms proves the inclusive <5 ms gate, but its exact percentile is a tooling gap. Observer overhead stays in union. GC windows now also have rig timing patches, unlike 14j; allocation/cadence comparisons are observational on this shared host.

### Visual check and exact failures

Separate cold background graphics rig-test start, same fixture Tuesday 15:30, player x=215,z=0. Nine 1600×900 PNGs inspected: first close view includes a dressed walker in a red jacket and dark trousers; its return contains dressed walkers but the target is distant. The second close/return view is occluded by a building. Five pan stills contain sparse dressed walkers or empty/occluded sidewalk. No undressed body is seen in the inspected images; the images do not prove no invisible body or brief appearance flash, or unchanged visuals versus a synchronized baseline.

Two native walker handles were selected. After an 8 s camera-away interval, the first handle (`walker-a003dd287c154421abf30362d533be80`) still answered screen_pos and camera-follow; its return capture occurred after 11.914 s. The second (`walker-469c462227ce4d1aa31d9cfaac62f003`) returned `ops_view_stale_target` for both screen_pos get and camera follow; return after 11.871 s. A native body handle has no persistent resident ID and no release/reacquire event proof. Even the surviving handle cannot establish that the same resident was assigned before and after, or that release/reacquire happened. Same-resident look stability remains unverified; this is not an asserted appearance-change failure. The pan sequence used 24 camera operations over 121.914 s. All requested appearance-error strings have zero matches in both Player logs.

| Player.log string | Headless A matches | Background B matches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Appearance meshes unavailable | 0 | 0 |
| Empty appearance | 0 | 0 |
| Merged body | 0 | 0 |
| Merged body already has blendshapes | 0 | 0 |
| Merged body vertex layout differs | 0 | 0 |

- `python3 scripts/mac-agent call teleport {"x": 215, "z": 0}` → `Missing "who": "player" or a food vehicle's id.`.
- `python3 scripts/mac-agent op screen_pos {"action": "get", "target": {"kind": "walker", "id": "walker-469c462227ce4d1aa31d9cfaac62f003"}}` → `{ "error": "ops_view_stale_target", "reply": { "ok": false, "id": "9832f911693340308264b5eac50a8340", "session": "5cecf2c6bbea47769b9ce83575df334e", "error": "ops_view_stale_target" } }`.
- `python3 scripts/mac-agent op camera {"action": "follow", "target": {"kind": "walker", "id": "walker-469c462227ce4d1aa31d9cfaac62f003"}, "offset": {"x": 0, "y": 4, "z": -6}, "seconds": 10}` → `{ "error": "ops_view_stale_target", "reply": { "ok": false, "id": "1f22729883314256aca2a7a02c524bef", "session": "5cecf2c6bbea47769b9ce83575df334e", "error": "ops_view_stale_target" } }`.

The second walker handle went stale; the first remained readable. The initial teleport omitted who=player and was refused before mutation; the corrected call succeeded. The first gc population read after native load returned `Warning: [Persistent City] gc population refused: no active city.`; asynchronous activation completed before the next read confirmed reached=3000. No window opened before confirmation. No ops_load_* failure, staging refusal or runtime stop occurred.

### Literal Expected lines and outcomes

**PR #284**

## In-game checks
All locked-PC, none input-only. Fixture FT GR5 13f Timing v1, 1,000 residents / 2,000 visitors.
1. **Day GC window.** Setup: clock 15:30, idle camera, speed 1 after a 20→1 change. Steps: 600 s gc window. Expected: report gen0, pause p95, heap, mod, physical, advance and every segment and sub-segment against rig 15f. `mod_routes_rebuild` well below 83.9 MB; food, planning and citizen leaves below 15f.
2. **Night GC window.** Same at 01:00. Expected: the same report; `mod_routes_rebuild` well below 58.7 MB.
3. **Street window.** Setup: daytime. Steps: 600 s street window with pans and a 1→2→1 rate change. Expected: UpdateCity and mod-work p95 under 5 ms; every ≥30 ms spike listed with phase, detail, sub and gc_phase, none from retime/`mod_routes_rebuild`, `physical_spawn_appearance` or `mod_rlo`; `phase_spikes_30ms`, retained and `phase_spikes_truncated=false`; whole-frame p95/max reported separately; the `Clock retime: body release … ms over N updates` lines copied.
4. **Look stability.** Setup: daytime street. Steps: follow 5 residents through a speed change (body release and reacquire), then reload and find them again. Expected: dressed, animated bodies with the same look before and after, and none of "Appearance meshes unavailable", "Empty appearance" or "Merged body" in Player.log.
5. **Release frames.** Setup: daytime street with bodies and cars on screen. Steps: change speed 1→2 and watch the release updates. Expected: bodies and cars not yet released hold still or fade for at most a few frames with no visible jump, and no body stays behind after the new population appears. Report `RetimeReleaseSteps` (the N in the log line), how many of those updates the ambient walker restore took, and the mod-work time of each release update, including the car-pool and body-pool updates. No walker that RLO took over for an incident or ragdoll during the release gets its collider re-enabled or starts walking.


**PR #282**

## In-game checks
All locked-PC, none input-only.
1. **Day GC window.** Setup: FT GR5 13f Timing v1, 1,000 residents / 2,000 visitors, clock 15:30, idle camera, speed 1 after a 20 to 1 change. Steps: run a 600 s gc window. Expected: report gen0, pause p95, heap, mod, physical, advance and every segment and sub-segment vs 15d. physical_spawn_appearance well below 33.5 MB. The look diagnostics show `fast merges` > 0 and `failed merges` 0. mod_routes_nodes near 0.5 MB if the rate returned to one seen earlier in the session.
2. **Night GC window.** Same at 01:00. Expected: appearance well below 14.1 MB; report every segment vs 15d night.
3. **Street window.** Setup: same fixture, daytime. Steps: 600 s street window with pans and at least one clock-rate change and back. Expected: report UpdateCity and mod-work p95 and every ≥30 ms spike with phase, detail, sub and gc_phase, plus whole-frame p95/max separately. The phase recorder reports `phase_spikes_30ms`, `phase_spikes_retained` and `phase_spikes_truncated=false`. Note any spike from retime/mod_routes_rebuild, physical_spawn_appearance or mod_rlo with its whole-frame time.
4. **Look stability.** Setup: same fixture, daytime street. Steps: follow 5 residents through body release and reacquire, change speed once, reload and find them again. Expected: dressed and animated bodies with blendshapes applied, the same look per resident before and after, `failed merges` 0, and none of "Appearance meshes unavailable", "Empty appearance" or "Merged body" in Player.log.

**PR #246**

4. **Unrentable home footprint (input-only).** Setup: the city from check 1. Steps: pick three residential buildings with no rentable interior, including one rotated off the world axes and one with a yard or sidewalk under it. Compare each Home place's area evidence (footprint x floors x 0.6) and floor count with the visible building. Expected: footprint within about 1.5x of the visible ground area and floors within one of the visible storeys. `ReadFootprint` takes the world-axis bounds of every enabled non-trigger collider, so rotated buildings and ground colliders read large. If this check fails, the read moves to the main mesh in local space.
5. **Unreadable and empty tally (input-only).** Steps: read the `unrentable homes ... unreadable=N empty=M` line after load. Expected: buildings under one storey count as empty, not unreadable, and the omitted-places warning only counts unreadable ones.

### B — #293 check 2 and #290 checks 2–4: reload / quit consistency

**PASS** for cold reload, immediate reload and save-then-quit. The first immediate load/stop dispatches followed trigger returns in 2.197 / 1.535 s, with `in_progress=true` and `compress_thread_alive=true`. Two repeat cases add a diagnostic read before dispatch: both observed `mode=background`, then confirmed compression still alive before load/stop. A newly loaded runtime resets its last-save mode field, so its initial `main-thread` value is not used to describe the preceding save.

Check-1 native serialized input and final file have identical `foodtrucks:state`: **2491 characters**, SHA-256 `df5001bd08bd28c5be3795d8363426b4e21dc4596241575279b8a032b8c66b45`; trucks **0→0**. This fixture has no populated trucks. The source fixture text is 2,474 characters; Street Food rewrites its own version/save counter before serialization. Equality is against that save’s native input, then before/after reload, not against the older source fixture bytes.

### C — #293 check 3 / #290 check 5: forced refusal

**PASS.** Fault-points build staged while stopped/owned. Launcher uses inherited `subprocess.Popen` environment; `PC_FAULT_POINT=save:writer-refusal` was set only for the fault start and unset immediately afterwards in the controller. Saved only to the new `FT RIGTMP-fault-refusal-17k-mac` slot, never the fixture. Actual diagnostics:

```json
{
  "mode": "background",
  "writer.success": false,
  "writer.error": "Population save refused: Forced background save refusal (PC_FAULT_POINT=save:writer-refusal).",
  "compress.splice": "Spliced",
  "failed_marker": "failed:2",
  "previous_payload_preserved": true,
  "foodtrucks_input_output_equal": true,
  "foodtrucks_chars": 2490,
  "foodtrucks_sha256": "0132030fad7e719dd0dbeef4dd6a8af70a4a7d90a839aae6a4b66e1a94a6e788",
  "pending_token": false,
  "cleanup_mode": "background",
  "cleanup_splice": "Spliced"
}
```

The previous PC payload remained 6,050,970 characters. The failed marker is literally `failed:2`; the splice result is literally `Spliced` (not a fabricated combined “Spliced failed” field). Reload left `attached=false` and logged the refusal below. The new runtime’s refused counter is 0 because no city attached; that is not a successful activation. `pc population status` returned the exact unknown-command usage under tooling gaps; the refusal verdict uses the failed marker and startup log.

```text
[Mod:PersistentCity] Persistent City stopped: Load a synchronized pre-failure checkpoint or another city to restart Persistent City. This stopped save stays refused; native time continues. Save epoch refused: Population save refused: Forced background save refusal (PC_FAULT_POINT=save:writer-refusal). Native calendar continues; Persistent City is stopped. Unprocessed Persistent City demand is lost, not replayed. The original population payload is retained. Native saves remain playable with Persistent City stopped.
```

Cleanup: game stopped, standard package restaged, no fault variable in the standard launch, fault slot deleted with `after.exists=false`, and one ordinary save confirmed `background` / `Spliced` before D.

### A — release and reacquire

Cold loaded the sealed fixture, confirmed autosave suppression, replayed at 1× and waited for physical population preflight. Initial discovery ran before that preflight and found 45 unbound non-evidence walkers; fresh discovery after `Physical population active` selected five travelling residents with `binding.source: persistent_city`. All subsequent comparisons use resident targets, never a recycled walker handle.

Camera-only movement to x=-500/z=-400 left the bodies active. The physical radius follows the player, so the isolated test player was moved there with the camera. All five `get` calls then returned `ops_view_resident_absent`, confirming body loss. After returning player/camera to x=215/z=0, handles were re-listed and `get` retried at 1×. Four bodies reacquired. Their donor fields equal the pre-release fields and all generations changed. `pc:282` had no current body during retries and is omitted, as required by the brief. The initial `Clock retime:` completed before the judged reads; speed stayed 1× during A and its release/reacquire window.

### D — Persistent City absent / game GC comparison (PROVISIONAL)

| Window | Unity GC rows | Collection-count changes | Unity GC p95 ms | Mono heap B | Mono used B | Whole-frame p95 ms | Whole-frame max ms | Whole-frame counted/retained/truncated | Save clean |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gc-night | 14 | 7 | 28.1965 | 1471283200 | 1350254592 | 37.6126 | 429.9587 | 16899 / 1024 / true | True |
| rlo-night | 14 | 7 | 28.8854 | not exported | not exported | 54.4837 | 2822.1814 | 14464 / 1024 / true | True |

Collection counts are equal (7/7); Unity GC p95 differs by +2.44%. Heap within ±5% is not established: successful perf end exports GC pause and whole-frame records, but no Mono heap size/used fields; no op error is returned for those absent fields. Without PC its gc report is unavailable. This supports the collection-count comparison only, not a causal claim about who sets the heap.

With the game stopped and lease held, the original printed --stage-mod rollback ran first. The original PC folder was retained in <stage>/separation-original-mod; its isolated folder was left empty. `python3 scripts/install-mac.py --refresh-mods --mod PersistentCity` then recorded zero entries, with receipt backup `~/Library/Application Support/BigAmbitionsAgentTestsMac/receipt-backups/20261117T234946Z`. No receipt was hand-edited. The new headless rig-test process loaded the same sealed fixture, completed 1→2→1 starting at 00:50 and measured 600 s from 01:00. RLO 1.0.6 initialized; zero PC files, zero PC receipt entries, no PC staged_mod or activation lines. Other baseline mods remained installed: RLO-only here means Persistent City absent. Candidate was not restaged because the new F action is rejected by the installed protocol.

The first D preparation used five-second rate pulses and overshot 01:00, causing run_until to select day 4. It was interrupted before any sampler/perf begin. Only this role's controller/game were stopped. A fresh RLO-only process used 0.5-second pulses and reached day 3 01:00; all reported D data comes from that retry. Attempt records remain in <stage>/separation-preparation-attempt-1. No measured window was shortened or replaced.

### Findings and exact tooling gaps

- Day steady mod allocation is 28.30% below 16h, repeat is 12.70% below 16h; night is 2.41% higher. Steady day gen0 improves 7→5, repeat 7→6; night changes 6→7. Sampler pause p95 worsens in both day windows, improves at night. These are provisional observations under different shared-host load.
- Food-event bytes day/repeat/night: 8,021,488 / 13,739,712 / 192 versus 16h 17,774,560 / 20,623,664 / 30,656. Closure-network bytes: 176 / 1,184 / 384 versus 480 / 46,032 / 720. Both requested allocation comparisons meet the corresponding 16h values; no retained ≥30 ms PC phase frame has either as dominant sub.
- Three day grow calls are individually ≥22 ms: frame 19956 physical_spawn_grow 38.033 ms; 21091 28.812 ms; 21719 72.130 ms. They are single-call grow costs. No street grow/bake detail ≥22 ms was observed. Day/repeat union spike counts are 24/29 versus 16h 8/19; night stays 0; street decreases 3→1 but union p95 rises 4.2911→5.1476 ms.
- After street 2→1 at 404.0 s, the population diagnostics report 58 frames waiting for routes (logical clock 3908.4), followed by zero (3916.0). This is the waitingFrames counter rendered as prose; there is no literal waitingFrames key in the bridge response. Final gate clearance reused is True; warmup also emitted False. Street frameDeferrals=26/10 (longest wait 3.40 s) is process-cumulative. Night frameDeferrals=6/1 (longest wait 0.20 s).

### D. Night separation (PROVISIONAL)

The first staged candidate answered perf_union status without refusal. The controller then waited for an extra preparatory 2× retime completion and timed out before arming. The separate attempt folder holds the evidence and printed rollback. Restoration and lease release passed. The same pinned DLL was re-staged under a new lease and check 4 was retried with a direct approach to 01:00 at 1×. No first-attempt measurement is included.

Initial probe receipt `~/Library/Application Support/BigAmbitionsAgentTestsMac/receipt-backups/20261118T132421Z`. The retry Persistent City stage receipt is `~/Library/Application Support/BigAmbitionsAgentTestsMac/receipt-backups/20261118T133714Z`.

`tools/perf-union-probe/build_probe.py --game-managed <shim>` built SHA-256 `71c60fffd497b1da99e5950c531e01bcaa1b0a12c729f537406a228038d6b9b1`. Scope hash `4e2e1f1bdedf7f54b625c67d448979ddce92d609d5134c138ef190b59f84e55b`. The reference arm requires the observed candidate factor.

Probe backup `~/Library/Application Support/BigAmbitionsAgentTestsMac/receipt-backups/20261118T133717Z`.
